master.desc: Currently pursuing a master's degree focused on cloud architectures, as well as the creation and maintenance of large-scale distributed systems. A clear requirement for this future degree is making the real leap to a European level, using English as the main language, to further my international expansion.

ielts.desc: Certified advanced level of English. The IELTS exam (International English Language Testing System) is the most widely accepted English exam in the world for certifying language proficiency for academic or migration purposes, designed for those seeking to enter universities or higher education programs with a fully functional foundation.

erasmus.desc: Studied abroad as part of the Erasmus+ program, pushing myself out of my comfort zone and learning to deal with challenges, preparing my leap into the future, with the goal of making the jump into the international academic world.

desc: Building a strong foundation in software engineering principles, algorithms, and system design, as well as development standards such as agile methods and Scrum methodology.
Just as importantly, I've built friendships and connections that mean a lot to me and have helped me grow both professionally and personally, shaping the person I am today.
Teaching Python to two 14-year-old students who were just starting out in programming, along with math tutoring for a 16-year-old student.

Even though these classes were completely voluntary and didn't come with any qualification or pay, they helped me a lot in terms of tutoring and teaching experience, as well as reinforcing my own knowledge. Because nothing makes you reflect more than people who are just starting out and make you consider things you never even thought about back when you began your academic life as a computer scientist.

As a curricular goal, I have to complete my internship at the prestigious company Indra Group. A Spanish multinational company that is a benchmark in defense, aerospace, and advanced technologies, with a long track record and a strong international reputation.

projects.title: Featured Projects
projects.subtitle: A selection of my recent work from GitHub.

gymhub.title: GymHub
gymhub.description: Personal workout tracker that syncs with Google Calendar and Fitbit. Full-stack ecosystem with a FastAPI + SQLite backend, a React/Vite web dashboard with analytics, and a native Android app.

aissMiner.title: AISS-Miner
aissMiner.description: A microservices-based ecosystem designed to aggregate and unify repository data from GitHub, GitLab, and BitBucket.

heatDistribution.title: HeatDistribution
heatDistribution.description: Parallel heat transfer simulator using Jacobi and SOR methods. Built with C/C++ and OpenMP for multi-threaded computation (up to 20 threads), with Raylib for real-time visualization and CSV performance logging.

usbGpt.title: Usb-GPT
usbGpt.description: Functional interface with preloaded models to use on a USB drive or hard disk to talk with an offline Artificial Intelligence model.

rockPaperScissors.title: RockPaperScissors
rockPaperScissors.description: AI-powered Rock-Paper-Scissors game using MediaPipe for real-time hand gesture recognition. Built with React (Vite) and FastAPI.

aiTravelAssistant.title: AI-travel-assistant
aiTravelAssistant.description: Interactive web application built with Streamlit that generates detailed, day-by-day travel itineraries using Google Gemini and GoogleTTS.

lensPortExtension.title: LensPortExtension
lensPortExtension.description: A browser extension that replicates Google Lens functionality. Performs real-time OCR and translation on any webpage area.
